stories.title: 3 dead after Los Angeles news helicopter crashes in Chatsworth

en.title: 3 dead after Los Angeles news helicopter crashes in Chatsworth
en.summary: A news helicopter crashed in Chatsworth, Los Angeles, resulting in three deaths. The crash occurred near the location of a previous fatal Metro bus accident in the same area.

stories.title: Blanche says "of course" White House will comply with Supreme Court decision on mail ballots

en.title: Blanche says "of course" White House will comply with Supreme Court decision on mail ballots
en.summary: Attorney General Todd Blanche confirmed the White House will comply with a Supreme Court ruling that upheld a lower court block on new U.S. Postal Service mail voting regulations.

stories.title: Legal expert explains Supreme Court's decision to block Trump's mail-in voting rules

en.title: Legal expert explains Supreme Court's decision to block Trump's mail-in voting rules
en.summary: The Supreme Court rejected stricter mail-in voting regulations promoted by President Trump before the 2026 midterm elections. A legal analyst provides explanation of the court's decision.

stories.title: Blanche defends Trump's comments on Supreme Court after it rejects new mail-in voting restrictions

en.title: Blanche defends Trump's comments on Supreme Court after it rejects new mail-in voting restrictions
en.summary: President Trump characterized the Supreme Court's rejection of tighter mail-in voting rules as a Republican loss, citing cheating concerns. A Brookings analysis found minimal documented mail voting fraud cases across recent election cycles.

stories.title: Trump, the Supreme Court and the Postal Service: A History of Mail Voting

en.title: Trump, the Supreme Court and the Postal Service: A History of Mail Voting
en.summary: The Supreme Court blocked President Trump's effort to expand the role of mail voting in elections. The postal system has historically enabled voters to cast ballots remotely, notably during the Civil War.

stories.title: Trump admin. will comply with mail ballot ruling by Supreme Court, Blanche says

en.title: Trump admin. will comply with mail ballot ruling by Supreme Court, Blanche says
en.summary: The Supreme Court blocked the Postal Service from enforcing new mail voting rules before the midterm elections. The Trump administration indicated it would comply with the court's decision.

stories.title: Supreme Court Stands Up to Trump on Mail Voting and a Few Key Issues

en.title: Supreme Court Stands Up to Trump on Mail Voting and a Few Key Issues
en.summary: The Supreme Court has rejected several presidential initiatives including those on tariffs, citizenship, the National Guard, and election procedures.

stories.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close it, as judge again keeps Trump's name off

en.title: Kennedy Center board votes to close it, as judge again keeps Trump's name off
en.summary: The Kennedy Center board voted to close the arts venue for renovations amid concerns about financial and structural issues, as a judge again blocked adding Trump's name to the building.

stories.title: Trump slams the Supreme Court for rejecting his push to restrict mail ballots

en.title: Trump slams the Supreme Court for rejecting his push to restrict mail ballots
en.summary: President Trump criticized the Supreme Court after it rejected his effort to restrict mail-in voting in the midterm elections.

stories.title: Trump Slams Supreme Court Over Mail-In Voting Ruling

en.title: Trump Slams Supreme Court Over Mail-In Voting Ruling
en.summary: President Trump strongly criticized the Supreme Court regarding a mail-in voting decision, expressing dissatisfaction with justices he previously nominated.

stories.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump’s Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules

en.title: Supreme Court Blocks Trump's Bid to Restrict Mail-in Ballot Rules
en.summary: The Supreme Court rejected President Trump's attempt to restrict mail-in voting ahead of November's midterm elections.

stories.title: Supreme Court blocks sweeping mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections

en.title: Supreme Court blocks sweeping mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections
en.summary: The Supreme Court blocked mail ballot restrictions that the Trump administration had proposed as a fraud prevention measure, while voting rights groups warned the rules could cause election disruptions.

en.summary: The Singapore dollar declined in value against the U.S. dollar as investors awaited the Federal Reserve's policy decision.
